vdp.coordinates: box-normalized y = S x, S = diag(2 / (hi - lo))
vdp.shape: linearization quadratic y'Py (A'P + PA = -I in y), scaled to unit largest eigenvalue
vdp.init: the same quadratic, rescaled to its largest certified level
vdp.alternation: multiplier step: bisect the largest level with s2, s3 and rescale V; bisect the largest beta with s1; V step: maximize beta over V with s1, s2, s3 fixed; re-normalize
vdp.stopping_rule: 3 iterations without a 0.1 % gain in beta, or 60 iterations, or an infeasible step
vdp.solver: Clarabel (CVXPY), SCS (max_iters 20000) if Clarabel raises; a solve is accepted with status 'optimal' or 'optimal_inaccurate'; statuses were not stored
vdp.stop: stall: 3 iterations without a 0.1 % gain in beta
